phase_name: Targeted re-OCR of the confirmed defective pages

objectives.description: Entire phase: backup, re-OCR, splice, verification, swap

deviations.description: Back up and re-OCR the confirmed defective pages
deviations.reason: Phase 1's baseline measurement falsified the premise this phase depends on -- no genuine defect exists to fix. Directed by the requester after Phase 1's halt was reported.

exclusion_reason: No defective pages exist per Phase 1's measurement; re-OCR would be work performed to make a narrative true rather than to fix anything.
